instructions: NeMo-Speech.cpp is a C++17 runtime exclusively for NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Diarization (Sortformer V3), built on ggml from the pinned llama.cpp submodule. The supported build backends are CPU, CUDA, Metal and Vulkan. The public C API and CLI expose local GGUF inference. Review changes for concrete correctness, numerical parity, streaming-state, portability and dependency issues. Do not infer DER accuracy from functional parity tests. patches/ contains NVIDIA-authored ggml changes; review their operation preconditions and supported backends.

rules.rule: Look for wrong output, crashes, memory errors, races, stale state, empty and boundary inputs, numerical drift, and chunk-size-dependent streaming behavior. Check CPU and available accelerator fallback paths.

Check hot-path regressions such as added synchronization, redundant work, extra backend copies, unintended CPU fallback, and ineffective caches. Do not propose computation changes outside the requested scope.

Check assumptions tied to one GPU architecture, backend, operating system or compiler. Confirm that CMake dependencies match the standalone diarization target and that exported C API symbols remain stable.
Check that documentation and review claims match current Nemotron 3-only behavior. Distinguish functional parity from DER accuracy.
